entries.task_id: bamasi aali|mu|mbunga ya united nations mu milawo ya malembo amumbunga eeyi akasyomenzya lusyomo mu milawo ya lwaanguluko lwa muntu
entries.description: bamasi aali mu mbunga ya United Nations mu milawo ya malembo amumbunga eeyi akasyomenzya lusyomo mu milawo ya lwaanguluko lwa muntu
entries.subject: bamasi aali
entries.object: mbunga ya United Nations mu milawo ya malembo amumbunga eeyi akasyomenzya lusyomo mu milawo ya lwaanguluko lwa muntu

spans.text: Kakuli ncintu cipati kusumpula lumvwano akati kamasi, kakuli bantu bamasi aali mu mbunga ya United Nations mu milawo ya malembo amumbunga eeyi akasyomenzya lusyomo mu milawo ya lwaanguluko lwa muntu, kubulemu alimwi abuvubi bwamuntu alimwi alwanguluko lweelene ku basankwa abakaintu alimwi akuba amakanze akusumpula bukkale bwabuumi bwabo mukuliiba kunji.

entries.task_id: muswaangano mupati|waambili|zya zyeezyi: eeci cizumino ca kwaambilizya lwaanguluko lwa muntu kuba nenzila ngubauba yabantu boonse alimwi amasi oonse kujana
entries.description: Muswaangano Mupati waambili zya zyeezyi: Eeci cizumino ca kwaambilizya lwaanguluko lwa muntu kuba nenzila ngubauba yabantu boonse alimwi amasi oonse kujana
entries.subject: Muswaangano Mupati
entries.object: zya zyeezyi: Eeci cizumino ca kwaambilizya lwaanguluko lwa muntu kuba nenzila ngubauba yabantu boonse alimwi amasi oonse kujana

spans.text: Lino aboobo, Muswaangano Mupati (Generl Assembly) waambili zya zyeezyi: Eeci cizumino ca kwaambilizya lwaanguluko lwa muntu kuba nenzila ngubauba yabantu boonse alimwi amasi oonse kujana, kumasimpilo kuti muntu oonse alimwi azyibeela zya buleya, kuyeeya cisyomezyo eeci lyoonse mu myoyo, ciya kusola mbocikonzya kuyiisya alimwi akusumpula kulemeka lwaanguluko alimwi akuliiba alimwi kwiinda munzila isumpukide, masi alimwi akubantu bamumasi aali mubweendelezi bwa bantu bambi.

Lino aboobo, Muswaangano Mupati (Generl Assembly) waambili zya zyeezyi: Eeci cizumino ca kwaambilizya lwaanguluko lwa muntu kuba nenzila ngubauba yabantu boonse alimwi amasi oonse kujana, kumasimpilo kuti muntu oonse alimwi azyibeela zya buleya, kuyeeya cisyomezyo eeci lyoonse mu myoyo, ciya kusola mbocikonzya kuyiisya alimwi akusumpula kulemeka lwaanguluko alimwi akuliiba alimwi kwiinda munzila isumpukide, masi alimwi akubantu bamumasi aali mubweendelezi bwa bantu bambi.

entries.task_id: akaianwe amulandu|mu|nkuta mbuli bwaamba mulawo libetekwa alimwi ulizumizyilwe kujmana bamwiimiminina libetekwa mulandu wakwe
entries.description: akaianwe amulandu mu nkuta mbuli bwaamba mulawo libetekwa alimwi ulizumizyilwe kujmana bamwiimiminina libetekwa mulandu wakwe
entries.subject: akaianwe amulandu
entries.object: nkuta mbuli bwaamba mulawo libetekwa alimwi ulizumizyilwe kujmana bamwiimiminina libetekwa mulandu wakwe

spans.text: Oonse wapegwa mulandu ulaangulukide kwiitwa kuti ucisalalakusikila akaianwe amulandu mu nkuta mbuli bwaamba mulawo libetekwa alimwi ulizumizyilwe kujmana bamwiimiminina libetekwa mulandu wakwe.

entries.task_id: kwiinda|mu|milawo ya cisi antela ijatikizya masi oonse
entries.description: kwiinda mu milawo ya cisi antela ijatikizya masi oonse
entries.subject: kwiinda
entries.object: milawo ya cisi antela ijatikizya masi oonse

spans.text: Kunyina ukonzya kujanwa mulandu kuti kakuli cintu comwe cicaala citakonzyi kupa kuti ube mulandu, kwiinda mu milawo ya cisi antela ijatikizya masi oonse, ciindi mulandu ooyu niwakacitika.

entries.task_id: alikke antela|mu|mbunga ya bana maleya nokuba kuliiba alikke
entries.description: alikke antela mu mbunga ya bana maleya nokuba kuliiba alikke
entries.subject: alikke antela
entries.object: mbunga ya bana maleya nokuba kuliiba alikke

spans.text: Muntu oonse ulaangulukide kuliyeeyela, kulisalila cikombelo ncayanda; lwaanguluko oolu lulajatikizya alusyomo ndwajisi alikke antela mu mbunga ya bana maleya nokuba kuliiba alikke, kutobela buyiisya cikombelo antela walo kuyyiisya, alimwi akukomba.
